source: U.S. Census Bureau — American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates (2020-2024)

fields.cost_burdened_owners_pct: (B25091_008E+009E+010E+011E) / B25091_001E — owners WITH A MORTGAGE paying 30%+, over all owners; the numerator excludes mortgage-free owners by construction, so this understates burden among owners overall
fields.ami_estimate: population-weighted mean of county income_limits.ami_4person over 64 counties — HUD FMR FY2026 and Income Limits FY2026. HUD, not ACS: different source and vintage from every other field here. A FOUR-PERSON standard: do not compare it against an all-sizes rent.
fields.affordable_rent_60pct: population-weighted county affordable_rents_60pct, weighted again by the statewide renter bedroom mix (B25042_010E-015E) so it spans the same unit sizes as median_gross_rent — HUD FMR FY2026 and Income Limits FY2026. Compare THIS against median_gross_rent, not a figure derived from ami_estimate.
